camera.view: top-down (orthographic-looking) view onto a plain light-grey ground/water plane with radial vignette; no perspective cues; no camera motion (median background reproduces every frame to <=9 grey levels outside the fish/shadow)

objects.name: koi_fish
objects.description: single koi carp seen from above, orange/red and white scales with a few black spots, translucent pale head and white fins; head points LEFT (-x); swims right-to-left across the image
objects.visible_frames: 0-71 (frames 0-~10: tail fin cut by / touching the right image edge)
objects.reference_point: body_cx/body_cy (centroid of the orange/white body core mask) and match_x/match_y (template-matched head+trunk path, smoother); origin of the rig is not visible - use these
objects.fin_span_px_typical: 230-262 (pectoral fin tip to tip, across the body)
objects.heading_deg_image: axis_angle_deg column (180 = pointing -x; negative = nose tilted up in image); ranges ~ +176..-168

objects.name: fish_shadow
objects.description: dark grey cast shadow of the koi on the ground plane, offset up/right of the fish early and to the left/up (ahead of the nose) late; moves with the fish; NOT the fish
objects.track: shadow_cx/shadow_cy columns in tracks/koi_fish.csv (centroid of dark pixels, approximate)

objects.name: ground_plane
objects.description: uniform light-grey background (value ~180-218, brighter centre, darker corners); no markings, no other objects

events.event: motion starts (first non-zero displacement, ~23.9 px/frame immediately)
vertical drift changes sign: moving slightly down (+y ~2 px/frame) until ~frame 20, ~0 frames 20-26, up (-y ~2 px/frame) frames 27-49, ~0 after ~50
frame 71 nearly identical to frame 70 (displacement ~0.5 px) - motion ends
